core_obligations: Choose representatives (proof lines 3669-3675): the author replaces the given object by a K-flat complex with flat terms, so that all three derived pullbacks are computed by the naive pullbacks.

Compare the two composites (proof lines 3675-3681): the naive pullbacks satisfy f^*g^* = (g f)^*, and pullback preserves the class of representatives used, so the two composites agree, which gives the asserted identity of functors.
proof_roadmap: Use K-flat resolutions with flat terms so that the derived pullbacks are naive.
Apply the composition identity for naive pullbacks.
Conclude the identity of derived functors.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the derived pullback is compatible with composition of morphisms of ringed topoi (statement lines 3657-3667). The proof chooses representatives on which the derived pullback is the naive one (proof lines 3669-3675) and then applies the composition identity for naive pullbacks, which is legitimate because the class of representatives is preserved (proof lines 3675-3681). The non-formal content is the choice of representatives making the comparison naive. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one identity.
